main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The science and spirituality behind the millennium
header_desc: The union of the Condor and the Eagle reveals that the Christ condition is an essence beyond religion that allows us to discover our dual consciousness, offering at the same time a scientific and spiritual explanation of what mystical eschatology calls <q>the rapture</q>, <q>the new heaven and the new earth</q> and the <q>resurrection of the dead</q>.
left_title: From the material 🧠 psyche ┻ to the divine ❤️ pneuma ✝️
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO has mass and creates the temporal-material illusion of the psyche; to counteract it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and spaceless —the ONE—, which manifests through the ❤️ pneuma.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere —our pneuma— resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩ of the Invisible Father. There lies the land of unity and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Human consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ (represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️) and the material |EGO⟩ (represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠). This reveals to us that we possess a free will of perception which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩, thus the mentioned <q>rapture</q> is nothing more than a spiritual awakening.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩ of Yaldabaoth. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle { footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)}
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(01:13 -- 02:42)}
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's break of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_title: Chapter 3: Consciousness and Space-Time { footnotesize color{golddark}(02:47 -- 05:19)}
cap3_desc: The conceptual ensemble Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain; it precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_title: Chapter 4: Gnosis and Material Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(05:27 -- 08:39)}
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as the soul's imprisonment. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and The Prison of the Demiurge { footnotesize color{golddark}(08:43 -- 10:16)}
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, a self-centered god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and Universal Hemispheres { footnotesize color{golddark}(10:23 -- 14:38)}
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, contrasted with Jesus' revolutionary message dismantling the system of imperial slavery.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos { footnotesize color{golddark}(14:40 -- 16:30)}
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— it is there that Jesus' phrase resonates most strongly: «The Father and I are one». Could this have had a hidden message about the deep connection between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
